fields.climate: tropical monsoon; rainy season (May to November); dry season (December to April)
fields.terrain: mostly rugged mountains; some plains and plateaus
fields.resources: timber, hydropower, gypsum, tin, gold, gemstones
fields.farm: cassava, root vegetables, rice, sugarcane, vegetables, bananas, maize, rubber, coffee, watermelons
fields.industries: mining (copper, tin, gold, gypsum); timber, electric power, agricultural processing, rubber, construction, garments, cement, tourism
fields.languages: Lao (official), French, English, various ethnic languages
fields.legal: civil law system similar in form to the French system
fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary military service; mandatory military service for men 18-35 with a minimum 18-month service obligation
